programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf"
programme.sub-title: Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes"
programme.sub-title: Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of McVitie's Biscuits"
programme.desc: The McVitie's factory in Carlisle, Cumbria, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favourite biscuits are made, 24 hours a day, in one of Britain's biggest factories and oldest biscuit factory in the world.

programme.title: California Innovation Nation S1 - "The Dream Is Dead: Long Live the Dream"
programme.sub-title: The Dream Is Dead: Long Live the Dream

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Igor Zaripov"

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Scott Flansburg"
programme.desc: Thom’s in Nevada, tracking down world record-holding mathlete Scott Flansburg, who’s able to crunch numbers faster than a calculator.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Jerry Miculek"
programme.desc: Thom heads to Louisiana to meet Jerry Miculek, the human machine gun who can fire a handgun faster than an automatic weapon.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Fire Gloves, Enamel"

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Wood Stoves, Indigo, Synthesiser"
programme.desc: How do they make wood burning stoves that bring warmth to the bleak Norwegian winter? Plus, how do build the synthesiser that changed music forever?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Morgan Cars, Bamboo Cotton, Toilets"
programme.desc: How do they assemble the reinvented Morgan 3 Wheeler? Plus, how do they protect firefighters' hands from heat, flame and chemical attack?

programme.desc: How do they make wind turbines with twice the wingspan of a Boeing? Plus, how do they mould car tyres from the ooze of a tree?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Ammo, Dental Drill, Road Markings"
programme.desc: How do they make the tank piercing super bullet? Plus, how do they forge the infamous torture weapon, the dentist's drill?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Giant Power Station, Smallest Aircraft"
programme.desc: How do they make giant floating power stations that provide power around the world? Plus, how do they fabricate the world's smallest aircraft?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Crayons, Mirrors"

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Electric Race Cars, Mead"

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Steam-Powered Boat, Waterwall"
programme.desc: How do they build the famous steam-powered paddleboats that cruise the Mississippi River? How did they create the powerful defence system called 'the waterwall'?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Paving Stones, Tuxedo"
programme.desc: How do they make modern paving stones and how has the process changed over thousands of years? Plus, how do they create a traditionally tailored tuxedo suit?

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones"
programme.sub-title: Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
programme.sub-title: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection
programme.desc: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck"
programme.sub-title: RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck
programme.desc: We're at Royal Air Force station Brize Norton, Oxfordshire, where we've been given an exclusive look at the RAF's ground-breaking, multi-role refuelling and transporter aircraft, the Voyager.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Targeting & Tracking, Navigation, Seagoing Drones"
programme.desc: We reveal an experimental sensor, monitoring and targeting system developed for troops by the UK's Defence Science and Technology Laboratory and Roke Manor Research. The iXblue Marins navigation black box guides navy ships.

programme.sub-title: NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping
programme.desc: We visit NATO's Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation in La Spezia, Italy. We learn how the world's oceans are one of the last places that military technology can be hidden from prying eyes.

programme.sub-title: Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics
programme.desc: With an increasing terrorist threat to ports and shipping, the Swedish manufacturer SAAB has developed the Sea Wasp, an under-water robot for detecting explosive devices.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Warrior Vehicles, British Special Forces"
programme.desc: We're in Scotland for Unmanned Warrior, the key international military exercise using unmanned underwater, surface and airborne vehicles. We visit the Italian textile manufacturer who's kitting from a revolutionary new form of wool.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Mastering Arms"
programme.desc: A weapon that has built Empires, toppled Kingdoms, and slaughtered millions, the story of the gun and how it has evolved throughout the centuries is long.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Advancing Destruction"
programme.desc: This episode tells the story of that journey showcasing both big and the small artillery and the impact they have had on warfare.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Triumphant On Land"
programme.desc: Highlighting some of the most influential movers ever to take to the battlefield including some of the most infamous tanks.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Ruling The Waves"
programme.desc: From the most deadly submarines ever seen to the infamous destroyers of the Second World War, this episode is the story of what it takes to rule the waves.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Conqeuring The Sky"
programme.desc: The evolution of mankind's desire to fly higher, move faster, and kill better all from within the cockpit.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Ultimate Annihilation"
programme.desc: Explore the destructive capability of machinery across all scales, the inventions designed to unleash maximum carnage, then and now.

programme.sub-title: A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle

programme.sub-title: A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher

programme.sub-title: A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs
programme.desc: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
programme.sub-title: Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch
programme.desc: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .
